source: Same Polish participants as the marginal table, DOI 10.1186/1465-9921-13-57
locator: Table 2, p. 3, univariable FEV1-on-FVC column and Results text
quantity: Within each sex, unadjusted Pearson correlation of the two volumes, and an ordinary least-squares regression of FEV1 in litres on FVC in litres. They express related information on the same individuals. No residual distribution or cross-population calibration is reported.
uncertainty: The published estimates are rounded and have no tabulated confidence intervals. The simple regression is not an individual identity. The reported SDs are rounded to one decimal place, so the displayed moments, slopes and correlations need not agree exactly. The table also contains age-adjusted regressions; individual age is unavailable in the construction task.
